g.text: Title: Power base - controller readiness and local supply interlock

g.desc: Title: Power base - controller readiness and local supply interlock

g.text: POWER BASE | COMMON GND | SCHEMATIC REVIEW DRAFT

g.desc: POWER BASE | COMMON GND | SCHEMATIC REVIEW DRAFT

g.text: Existing Rev C PCB is historical and does not match Rev D

g.text: Common GND, 3.3 V logic. CTRL_READY comes from the controller reset-health buffer.

g.desc: Common GND, 3.3 V logic. CTRL_READY comes from the controller reset-health buffer.

g.text: The power base owns all PWM pull-downs and hardware permission; no MCU firmware is required to block a missing controller.

g.desc: The power base owns all PWM pull-downs and hardware permission; no MCU firmware is required to block a missing controller.

g.text: R160 = 10k. Unplugged, controller reset or lost controller power => ENABLE_QUALIFIED LOW.

g.desc: R160 = 10k. Unplugged, controller reset or lost controller power => ENABLE_QUALIFIED LOW.

g.text: Only ENABLE_QUALIFIED enters the latch reset and DRIVE_PERMIT logic. Raw ENABLE_IN keeps its original local R82 pull-down.

g.desc: Only ENABLE_QUALIFIED enters the latch reset and DRIVE_PERMIT logic. Raw ENABLE_IN keeps its original local R82 pull-down.

g.text: BASE SUPPLY PRESENCE / INDEPENDENT OF OPEN-COLLECTOR FAULT

g.desc: BASE SUPPLY PRESENCE / INDEPENDENT OF OPEN-COLLECTOR FAULT

g.text: BASE_READY = BASE_LOGIC_OK AND DRV_PG_LOGIC. The MCU sub-board provides its receiver pull-down.

g.desc: BASE_READY = BASE_LOGIC_OK AND DRV_PG_LOGIC. The MCU sub-board provides its receiver pull-down.

g.text: FAULT_N remains Q8 open collector with a pull-up only in the MCU 3.3 V domain. A high FAULT_N alone does not prove base power.

g.desc: FAULT_N remains Q8 open collector with a pull-up only in the MCU 3.3 V domain. A high FAULT_N alone does not prove base power.

g.text: U26/U27 package power and 100 nF bypass stay on Hardware PWM gates. No added logic package.

g.desc: U26/U27 package power and 100 nF bypass stay on Hardware PWM gates. No added logic package.
